upstream.installation: git checkout plus PYTHONPATH (upstream has no package manifest)

runtime_requirements.cuda: runtime toolkit with nvcc, CUDART/driver/CRT/NVVM development files, gcc/g++, SM80+

upstream.source_usage: external checkout; no upstream source vendored or modified

scope.kernel_only: identical precomputed certified routes through state operation

pipeline.reason: native route-selection kernel does not exist

methodology.timed_region_excludes: route generation/certification, tensor allocation, reset, cloning, compilation, cache initialization
methodology.drift_protocol: 15% upstream sentinel threshold; at most three whole-measurement attempts, all retained

mfu_mbu.reason: random sparse state traffic and cache reuse are analytical, not hardware-counter measurements

optimization_history.hypothesis: explicit preallocated output cotangents remove scalar-loss graph work excluded by the upstream API
optimization_history.result: retained; scalar-loss differential correctness remains separate and untimed

optimization_history.hypothesis: store recurrent state cotangents in the BF16 semantic dtype while retaining FP32 arithmetic and reductions
optimization_history.result: retained after forward/backward differential gates and frozen memory gate

optimization_history.hypothesis: copy an upstream schedule to optimize already-passing cases
optimization_history.result: rejected: no measured native bottleneck and the schedule is not URM-owned evidence

spills.basis: cuobjdump LOCAL bytes; zero for all variants means no local spill storage

native_profile.synchronization: one CUDA event synchronization per timed sample, outside kernel; native forward kernel has no barrier
native_profile.atomics: none in forward; relaxed FP32 partial-reduction atomics in training backward
native_profile.occupancy_basis: register-bound theoretical ceiling on A10G; not a measured active-warp counter
